CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_finance_canonical_mark_posted(_org uuid, _source uuid, _journal uuid, _receipt uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  UPDATE public.canonical_transaction_states s
     SET financial_state = 'posted',
         journal_id = COALESCE(_journal, s.journal_id),
         receipt_id = COALESCE(_receipt, s.receipt_id),
         blocking_reason = NULL,
         next_action = 'Posted to the general ledger.',
         updated_at = now(),
         version = s.version + 1
   WHERE s.organization_id = _org
     AND s.source_id = _source
     AND s.financial_state NOT IN ('posted','reversed','not-applicable');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_finance_exception_register(_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _from date DEFAULT NULL::date, _to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, module text, reference text, source_id uuid, amount numeric, currency text, occurred_on date, age_days integer, status text, reason text, detail text, responsible text, action text, drill_to text, last_attempt timestamp with time zone, attempts integer, last_error text, branch_id uuid, property text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE org uuid:=public.current_org_id(); today date:=current_date; BEGIN
 IF org IS NULL OR NOT(public.is_org_admin() OR public.has_permission('finance','view') OR public.can_read_general_ledger()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT s.financial_state,s.source_module,coalesce(s.source_reference,s.source_id::text),s.source_id,s.amount,s.currency,s.occurred_at::date,greatest(0,today-s.occurred_at::date),s.financial_state,coalesce(s.blocking_reason,s.next_action),coalesce(s.blocking_reason,s.next_action),'Finance',coalesce(s.next_action,'Resolve at source and retry.'),
  CASE s.source_module WHEN 'inventory' THEN '/inventory/receiving' WHEN 'supplier_invoice' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'deposit' THEN '/finance/deposits' WHEN 'payment' THEN '/finance/queue' WHEN 'pos' THEN '/pos/orders' WHEN 'events' THEN '/events/bookings' WHEN 'delivery' THEN '/delivery' WHEN 'laundry' THEN '/laundry' ELSE '/finance/posting' END,
  s.updated_at,coalesce(r.attempts,0),r.last_error,s.branch_id,b.name
 FROM public.canonical_transaction_states s LEFT JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=s.branch_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT x.attempts,x.last_error FROM public.finance_posting_receipts x WHERE x.organization_id=s.organization_id AND public.neo_canonical_posting_module(x.source_module)=s.source_module AND x.source_id=s.source_id ORDER BY x.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)r ON true
 WHERE s.organization_id=org AND s.financial_state IN('blocked','failed')
   -- The night audit writes its own lifecycle record, so an exception run left
   -- a blocked record that the next run counted as a fresh exception forever.
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.night_audit_runs nr WHERE nr.id = s.source_id)
   AND (_branch IS NULL OR s.branch_id=_branch) AND (_from IS NULL OR s.occurred_at::date>=_from) AND (_to IS NULL OR s.occurred_at::date<=_to)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'blocked',public.neo_canonical_posting_module(r.source_module),coalesce(r.source_reference,r.source_id::text),r.source_id,r.amount,r.currency,coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date),greatest(0,today-coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)),'blocked','Posting receipt is not backed by a balanced posted journal','Posting receipt is not backed by a balanced posted journal','Finance','Repair the journal link or reverse and repost.','/finance/posting',r.updated_at,r.attempts,r.last_error,r.branch_id,b.name
 FROM public.finance_posting_receipts r LEFT JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=r.branch_id LEFT JOIN public.journal_entries j ON j.id=r.journal_id
 WHERE r.organization_id=org AND r.status='posted' AND (j.id IS NULL OR j.status<>'posted' OR abs(coalesce(j.total_debit,0)-coalesce(j.total_credit,0))>=0.01) AND (_branch IS NULL OR r.branch_id=_branch) AND (_from IS NULL OR coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)>=_from) AND (_to IS NULL OR coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)<=_to)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'failed',public.neo_canonical_posting_module(r.source_module),coalesce(r.source_reference,r.source_id::text),r.source_id,r.amount,r.currency,coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date),greatest(0,today-coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)),'failed',coalesce(nullif(r.last_error,''),'Posting attempt failed'),coalesce(nullif(r.last_error,''),'Posting attempt failed'),'Finance','Resolve the cause at source and retry the posting.',
  CASE public.neo_canonical_posting_module(r.source_module) WHEN 'inventory' THEN '/inventory/receiving' WHEN 'supplier_invoice' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'deposit' THEN '/finance/deposits' WHEN 'payment' THEN '/finance/queue' WHEN 'pos' THEN '/pos/orders' WHEN 'events' THEN '/events/bookings' WHEN 'delivery' THEN '/delivery' WHEN 'laundry' THEN '/laundry' ELSE '/finance/posting' END,
  r.updated_at,r.attempts,r.last_error,r.branch_id,b.name
 FROM public.finance_posting_receipts r LEFT JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=r.branch_id
 WHERE r.organization_id=org AND r.status IN('failed','blocked')
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.canonical_transaction_states s2 WHERE s2.organization_id=r.organization_id AND s2.source_id=r.source_id AND s2.financial_state IN('blocked','failed'))
   AND (_branch IS NULL OR r.branch_id=_branch) AND (_from IS NULL OR coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)>=_from) AND (_to IS NULL OR coalesce(r.occurred_on,r.created_at::date)<=_to)
 ORDER BY 1,7 DESC;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_finance_posting_queue(_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _from date DEFAULT NULL::date, _to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(source_module text, source_id uuid, reference text, source_status text, amount numeric, currency text, occurred_on date, eligible boolean, posting_status text, rule text, required_action text, drill_to text, last_error text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE org uuid:=public.current_org_id(); BEGIN
 IF org IS NULL OR NOT(public.is_org_admin() OR public.has_permission('finance','view')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT s.source_module,s.source_id,s.source_reference,s.operational_state,s.amount,s.currency,s.occurred_at::date,s.financial_state='eligible',s.financial_state,
  'Canonical state '||s.operational_state||' → '||s.financial_state,
  coalesce(s.next_action,CASE s.financial_state WHEN 'eligible' THEN 'Post to the general ledger.' WHEN 'blocked' THEN 'Resolve the source exception.' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Correct the failure and retry safely.' ELSE 'Complete the current operational stage.' END),
  CASE s.source_module WHEN 'inventory' THEN '/inventory/receiving' WHEN 'supplier_invoice' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN '/finance/payables' WHEN 'deposit' THEN '/finance/deposits' WHEN 'payment' THEN '/finance/queue' WHEN 'pos' THEN '/pos/orders' WHEN 'events' THEN '/events/bookings' WHEN 'delivery' THEN '/delivery' WHEN 'laundry' THEN '/laundry' ELSE '/finance/posting' END,
  coalesce(s.blocking_reason,(SELECT r.last_error FROM public.finance_posting_receipts r WHERE r.organization_id=s.organization_id AND public.neo_canonical_posting_module(r.source_module)=s.source_module AND r.source_id=s.source_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1))
 FROM public.canonical_transaction_states s WHERE s.organization_id=org AND (_branch IS NULL OR s.branch_id=_branch) AND (_from IS NULL OR s.occurred_at::date>=_from) AND (_to IS NULL OR s.occurred_at::date<=_to) AND s.source_module IN('pos','folio','laundry','events','delivery','inventory','supplier_invoice','supplier_payment','deposit','payment') AND s.financial_state NOT IN('posted','reversed','not-applicable') ORDER BY (s.financial_state='eligible') DESC,s.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 500;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_financial_state_set(_org uuid, _branch uuid, _module text, _source uuid, _reference text, _operational text, _financial text, _reason text, _amount numeric, _currency text, _accounting_date date, _journal uuid, _receipt uuid, _last_error text, _actor uuid, _detail jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF _org IS NULL OR _source IS NULL OR _module IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.financial_states AS fs (
    organization_id, branch_id, source_module, source_id, source_reference,
    operational_status, financial_status, reason, amount, currency,
    accounting_date, journal_id, receipt_id, last_error, actor_id,
    posted_at, reversed_at, detail, attempts, last_attempt_at
  ) VALUES (
    _org, _branch, _module, _source, _reference,
    _operational, COALESCE(_financial, 'pending'), _reason, COALESCE(_amount, 0), COALESCE(_currency, 'KES'),
    _accounting_date, _journal, _receipt, _last_error, _actor,
    CASE WHEN _financial = 'posted' THEN now() END,
    CASE WHEN _financial = 'reversed' THEN now() END,
    COALESCE(_detail, '{}'::jsonb), 0, now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (source_module, source_id) DO UPDATE SET
    branch_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.branch_id, fs.branch_id),
    source_reference = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.source_reference, fs.source_reference),
    operational_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.operational_status, fs.operational_status),
    financial_status = EXCLUDED.financial_status,
    reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
    amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
    currency = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.currency, fs.currency),
    accounting_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.accounting_date, fs.accounting_date),
    journal_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.journal_id, fs.journal_id),
    receipt_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.receipt_id, fs.receipt_id),
    last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
    actor_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.actor_id, fs.actor_id),
    posted_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.financial_status = 'posted' THEN COALESCE(fs.posted_at, now()) ELSE fs.posted_at END,
    reversed_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.financial_status = 'reversed' THEN COALESCE(fs.reversed_at, now()) ELSE fs.reversed_at END,
    detail = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.detail, fs.detail),
    attempts = fs.attempts + CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.financial_status IN ('failed','blocked') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    last_attempt_at = now()
  RETURNING fs.id INTO _id;

  RETURN _id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_gl_revenue_code(_category text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH n AS (
    SELECT replace(replace(lower(btrim(coalesce(_category,'other'))), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') AS c
  )
  SELECT CASE (SELECT c FROM n)
    WHEN 'accommodation' THEN '4010' WHEN 'room' THEN '4010' WHEN 'rooms' THEN '4010'
    WHEN 'lodging' THEN '4010'
    WHEN 'meal_plan' THEN '4020' WHEN 'restaurant' THEN '4020' WHEN 'food' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'fnb' THEN '4020' WHEN 'f_b' THEN '4020' WHEN 'dining' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'kitchen' THEN '4020' WHEN 'dine_in' THEN '4020' WHEN 'takeaway' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'take_away' THEN '4020' WHEN 'takeout' THEN '4020' WHEN 'counter' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'quick_service' THEN '4020' WHEN 'pickup' THEN '4020' WHEN 'walk_in' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'buffet' THEN '4020' WHEN 'banquet_food' THEN '4020' WHEN 'cafe' THEN '4020'
    WHEN 'bar' THEN '4030' WHEN 'beverage' THEN '4030' WHEN 'beverages' THEN '4030'
    WHEN 'drinks' THEN '4030' WHEN 'minibar' THEN '4030' WHEN 'poolbar' THEN '4030'
    WHEN 'pool_bar' THEN '4030'
    WHEN 'room_service' THEN '4040' WHEN 'in_room_dining' THEN '4040'
    WHEN 'laundry' THEN '4050' WHEN 'dry_cleaning' THEN '4050'
    WHEN 'event' THEN '4060' WHEN 'events' THEN '4060' WHEN 'banquet' THEN '4060'
    WHEN 'conference' THEN '4060'
    WHEN 'delivery' THEN '4070'
    WHEN 'transport' THEN '4080' WHEN 'airport_transfer' THEN '4080'
    ELSE '4090' END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_journal_canonical_sync()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'posted'
     AND NEW.source_document_id IS NOT NULL
     AND COALESCE(NEW.total_debit,0) = COALESCE(NEW.total_credit,0)
     AND COALESCE(NEW.total_debit,0) <> 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.neo_finance_canonical_mark_posted(NEW.organization_id, NEW.source_document_id, NEW.id, NULL);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_receipt_resolve_journal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.journal_id IS NULL AND lower(coalesce(NEW.status,'')) = 'posted' THEN
    SELECT j.id INTO NEW.journal_id
      FROM public.journal_entries j
     WHERE j.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
       AND j.source_document_id = NEW.source_id
       AND j.status = 'posted'
       AND abs(coalesce(j.total_debit,0) - coalesce(j.total_credit,0)) < 0.01
     ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC NULLS LAST, j.created_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_record_posting_receipt(_org uuid, _branch uuid, _module text, _source uuid, _reference text, _status text, _amount numeric, _currency text, _folio_line uuid, _detail text, _error text, _occurred date)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _mod text := _module;
        _key text := public.neo_canonical_posting_module(_module) || ':' || _source::text; _id uuid;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.finance_posting_receipts AS r
    (organization_id, branch_id, source_module, source_id, source_reference, idempotency_key,
     status, amount, currency, folio_line_id, detail, attempts, last_error, requested_by,
     posted_at, occurred_on)
  VALUES (_org, _branch, _mod, _source, _reference, _key, _status, coalesce(_amount,0),
          coalesce(_currency,'KES'), _folio_line, _detail, 1, _error, auth.uid(),
          CASE WHEN _status = 'posted' THEN now() END, _occurred)
  ON CONFLICT (organization_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
     SET status = CASE WHEN r.status = 'posted' THEN 'posted' ELSE excluded.status END,
         amount = excluded.amount,
         currency = excluded.currency,
         folio_line_id = coalesce(r.folio_line_id, excluded.folio_line_id),
         detail = excluded.detail,
         attempts = r.attempts + 1,
         last_error = excluded.last_error,
         requested_by = coalesce(excluded.requested_by, r.requested_by),
         posted_at = coalesce(r.posted_at, excluded.posted_at),
         occurred_on = coalesce(r.occurred_on, excluded.occurred_on)
  RETURNING r.id INTO _id;
  RETURN _id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fin_touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER financial_state_from_receipt AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.finance_posting_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION neo_financial_state_from_receipt()
CREATE TRIGGER posting_receipt_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.finance_posting_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION neo_posting_receipt_history()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_posting_receipt_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO public.finance_posting_receipt_history(receipt_id,organization_id,branch_id,source_module,source_id,attempt_number,status,amount,currency,journal_id,detail,error,actor_id)
 VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.branch_id,public.neo_canonical_posting_module(NEW.source_module),NEW.source_id,greatest(coalesce(NEW.attempts,1),1),NEW.status,NEW.amount,NEW.currency,NEW.journal_id,NEW.detail,NEW.last_error,NEW.requested_by)
 ON CONFLICT(receipt_id,attempt_number) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,journal_id=excluded.journal_id,detail=excluded.detail,error=excluded.error;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER receipt_resolve_journal BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.finance_posting_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION neo_receipt_resolve_journal()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_receipt_resolve_journal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.journal_id IS NULL AND lower(coalesce(NEW.status,'')) = 'posted' THEN
    SELECT j.id INTO NEW.journal_id
      FROM public.journal_entries j
     WHERE j.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
       AND j.source_document_id = NEW.source_id
       AND j.status = 'posted'
       AND abs(coalesce(j.total_debit,0) - coalesce(j.total_credit,0)) < 0.01
     ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC NULLS LAST, j.created_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_receipt_canonical_sync AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON public.finance_posting_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION neo_receipt_canonical_sync()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.neo_receipt_canonical_sync()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'posted' AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.neo_finance_canonical_mark_posted(NEW.organization_id, NEW.source_id, NEW.journal_id, NEW.id);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
